en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies will shield them. \q They will devour and trample the sling stones; \q they will drink and roar as if with wine. \q They will be filled like a sacrificial bowl, \q drenched like the corners of the altar.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies will protect them. \q They will destroy their enemies and trample on their sling stones. \q They will drink and shout as if they were full of wine. \q They will be full like the bowl used to splash blood on the altar, \q like the corners of the altar that are wet with blood.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos los defenderá, \q y devorarán y pisotearán las piedras de la honda; \q y beberán, harán estruendo como [con] vino, \q y se llenarán como el tazón, \q como las esquinas del altar.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos será su escudo. \q Devorarán y pisotearán las piedras de la honda; \q beberán y gritarán como embriagados de vino. \q Se llenarán como un tazón de los sacrificios, \q empapados como las esquinas del altar.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos los protegerá. \q Destruirán a sus enemigos y pisotearán las piedras de sus hondas. \q Beberán y gritarán como si estuvieran llenos de vino. \q Estarán llenos como el tazón que se usa para rociar sangre sobre el altar, \q como las esquinas del altar mojadas de sangre.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées les protégera, \q et ils dévoreront et fouleront les pierres de fronde ; \q et ils boiront, ils seront bruyants comme [sous l’effet du] vin, \q et ils seront remplis comme la coupe, \q comme les angles de [l’]autel.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées sera leur bouclier. \q Ils dévoreront et piétineront les pierres de fronde ; \q ils boiront et crieront comme s’ils avaient bu du vin. \q Ils seront remplis comme une coupe des sacrifices, \q trempés comme les angles de l’autel.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées les protégera. \q Ils détruiront leurs ennemis et piétineront leurs pierres de fronde. \q Ils boiront et crieront comme s’ils étaient pleins de vin. \q Ils seront pleins comme la coupe qui sert à verser le sang sur l’autel, \q comme les angles de l’autel mouillés de sang.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi atawalinda, \q nao watakula na kukanyaga mawe ya kombeo; \q nao watakunywa, watapiga kelele kama [kwa] divai, \q nao watajazwa kama bakuli, \q kama pembe za madhabahu.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi atakuwa ngao yao. \q Watakula na kuyakanyaga mawe ya kombeo; \q watakunywa na kupiga kelele kana kwamba wamelewa divai. \q Watajazwa kama bakuli la dhabihu, \q wakiloweshwa kama pembe za madhabahu.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi atawalinda. \q Watawaangamiza adui zao na kuyakanyaga mawe yao ya kombeo. \q Watakunywa na kupiga kelele kana kwamba wamejaa divai. \q Watajaa kama bakuli linalotumika kunyunyizia damu juu ya madhabahu, \q kama pembe za madhabahu zilizolowa damu.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân sẽ che chở họ, \q và họ sẽ ăn nuốt và giày đạp những viên đá ná; \q họ sẽ uống, sẽ ồn ào như [say] rượu, \q họ sẽ đầy tràn như cái chậu, \q như các góc bàn thờ.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân sẽ làm khiên che chở họ. \q Họ sẽ ăn nuốt và giày đạp những viên đá ná; \q họ sẽ uống và la hét như người say rượu. \q Họ sẽ đầy tràn như chậu dâng tế lễ, \q ướt đẫm như các góc bàn thờ.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân sẽ bảo vệ họ. \q Họ sẽ tiêu diệt kẻ thù và giày đạp lên đá ná của chúng. \q Họ sẽ uống và hò hét như người đầy rượu. \q Họ sẽ đầy tràn như cái chậu dùng để rảy huyết lên bàn thờ, \q như các góc bàn thờ ướt đẫm huyết.

ko.L: 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들을 보호하실 것이니, \q 그들이 삼키고 물맷돌을 짓밟을 것이다. \q 그들이 마시고 포도주에 [취한 듯] 떠들 것이며, \q 대접처럼 가득 차고, \q 제단 모퉁이처럼 [젖을 것이다].
ko.B: 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들의 방패가 되실 것이다. \q 그들이 물맷돌을 삼키고 짓밟을 것이다. \q 그들이 마시고 포도주에 취한 듯 소리칠 것이다. \q 그들은 제물의 피를 담는 대접처럼 가득 차고, \q 제단 모퉁이처럼 흠뻑 젖을 것이다.
ko.R: 하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들을 보호하실 것이다. \q 그들은 원수들을 멸하고 그들의 물맷돌을 짓밟을 것이다. \q 그들은 포도주에 잔뜩 취한 것처럼 마시고 소리칠 것이다. \q 그들은 제단에 피를 뿌릴 때 쓰는 대접처럼 가득 찰 것이다. \q 피에 젖은 제단 모퉁이처럼 될 것이다.

decisions.choice: defend them: shield them, as a city is shielded
decisions.reason: The verb is from the word for a shield. The LORD covers his people as he promised to cover Jerusalem (Isaiah 31:5; 37:35). The same verb is used of the LORD shielding Jerusalem in 12:8.

decisions.choice: devour and tread down the sling stones: the people overcome their enemies and their weapons
alternatives: they will tread down [their enemies like] sling stones
their sling stones will devour and subdue [the enemy]
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is brief. It most likely means that the people eat up their enemies, as a lion devours its prey (Numbers 23:24), and trample on the stones flung at them by the enemy's slingers, which cannot harm them. Some read it as the people treading down their enemies as if they were sling stones, or as the people's own sling stones overpowering the enemy. In every reading the people win the battle with the LORD's help.

decisions.choice: drink and roar as with wine; full like the bowl, like the corners of the altar: a victory feast pictured as a sacrifice
decisions.reason: The bowl is the basin used at the altar to catch the blood of the sacrifices and splash it against the altar's corners (Exodus 27:3; Leviticus 4:7). The victorious people are pictured as drinking deep, loud as with wine, and as filled like those bowls, as soaked as the altar's corners. The picture is of the blood of the enemy, as in Isaiah 34:6-7 and Ezekiel 39:17-19. The Septuagint makes the drinking explicit: "they will drink their blood like wine".

decisions.choice: the LORD of Armies; a sacrificial bowl; drenched (B); the bowl used to splash blood on the altar (R)
decisions.reason: "The LORD of hosts" is "the LORD of Armies" at Balanced and Readable, as in Isaiah. Balanced and Readable say what the bowl was for (m3). Readable supplies "their enemies" as the object of "devour", which the Hebrew leaves out (m2).

source.text: וְֽהוֹשִׁיעָ֞ם יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֛ם בַּיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא כְּצֹ֣אן עַמּ֑וֹ כִּ֚י אַבְנֵי־נֵ֔זֶר מִֽתְנוֹסְס֖וֹת עַל־אַדְמָתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And will save them Yahweh their God on that day, as [the] flock of his people; for stones of a crown [they will be], sparkling over his land.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God will save them in that day like a flock, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people; \q for [they will be] the stones of a crown, \q sparkling over {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} land.
en.B: On that day {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God will save them, for they are {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} flock. \q Like jewels in a crown \q they will sparkle over {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} land.
en.R: At that time {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God will rescue them, because they are {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people, the flock {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} cares for. \q They will shine in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} land \q like jewels in a crown.

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios los salvará en aquel día como a un rebaño, {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo; \q porque [serán] las piedras de una corona, \q que resplandecen sobre {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} tierra.
es.B: Aquel día {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios los salvará, porque son {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo, {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} rebaño. \q Como joyas de una corona \q resplandecerán sobre {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} tierra.
es.R: En ese tiempo {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios los rescatará, porque son {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo, el rebaño que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} cuida. \q Brillarán en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} tierra \q como joyas de una corona.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur Dieu les sauvera en ce jour-là comme un troupeau, {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple ; \q car [ils seront] les pierres d’une couronne, \q étincelant sur {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} terre.
fr.B: Ce jour-là, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur Dieu les sauvera, car ils sont {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple, {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} troupeau. \q Comme les joyaux d’une couronne, \q ils étincelleront sur {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} terre.
fr.R: En ce temps-là, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur Dieu les délivrera, car ils sont {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple, le troupeau dont {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} prend soin. \q Ils brilleront sur {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} terre \q comme les joyaux d’une couronne.

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao atawaokoa katika siku ile kama kundi, watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}; \q kwa maana [watakuwa] mawe ya taji, \q yakimetameta juu ya nchi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.B: Siku hiyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao atawaokoa, kwa maana wao ni watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, kundi {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}. \q Kama vito katika taji, \q watametameta juu ya nchi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.R: Wakati huo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao atawaokoa, kwa sababu wao ni watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, kundi analolitunza. \q Watang'aa katika nchi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} \q kama vito katika taji.

vi.L: Trong ngày ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ sẽ giải cứu họ như bầy chiên, là dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q vì [họ sẽ là] những viên đá của mão miện, \q lấp lánh trên đất {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Vào ngày ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ sẽ cứu họ, vì họ là dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là bầy chiên của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Như ngọc quý trên mão miện, \q họ sẽ lấp lánh trên đất {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Vào lúc ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ sẽ giải cứu họ, vì họ là dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là bầy chiên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chăm sóc. \q Họ sẽ chiếu sáng trên đất {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} \q như ngọc quý trên mão miện.

ko.L: 그날에 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들을 양 떼같이, 그분의 백성으로 구원하실 것이다. \q 그들은 면류관의 보석이 되어 \q 그분의 땅 위에서 빛날 것이다.
ko.B: 그날에 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들을 구원하실 것이다. 그들은 그분의 백성, 그분의 양 떼이기 때문이다. \q 그들은 면류관에 박힌 보석처럼 \q 그분의 땅에서 반짝일 것이다.
ko.R: 그때에 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들을 구해 내실 것이다. 그들은 그분의 백성이고, 그분께서 돌보시는 양 떼이기 때문이다. \q 그들은 그분의 땅에서 \q 왕관의 보석처럼 빛날 것이다.

decisions.choice: as the flock of his people: the LORD as shepherd of his people
decisions.reason: The people are the LORD's flock, and he is their shepherd (Psalm 23:1; 80:2; Ezekiel 34:11-16). The picture prepares for chapters 10-11 and 13:7, where the shepherds of the people are judged and the LORD gathers his flock.

decisions.choice: stones of a crown, sparkling over his land: the people will be the land's treasure
decisions.reason: The jewels of a royal crown catch the light. The people saved by the LORD will be like jewels set on his land, the crown of his work. Isaiah 62:3 calls Zion "a crown of beauty in the LORD's hand". The verb for "sparkling" is rare and may also mean "raised up like a banner".

decisions.choice: in that day (L); On that day (B); At that time (R)
decisions.reason: The phrase follows the wording set in Isaiah. Balanced and Readable put it first, as English does; Readable says "the flock he cares for" and puts the comparison with jewels after the verb.

source.text: כִּ֥י מַה־טּוּב֖וֹ וּמַה־יָפְי֑וֹ דָּגָן֙ בַּֽחוּרִ֔ים וְתִיר֖וֹשׁ יְנוֹבֵ֥ב בְּתֻלֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: For how [great is] its goodness, and how [great is] its beauty! Grain will make young men flourish, and new wine young women.

en.L: For how great [is] its goodness, and how great its beauty! \q Grain will make [the] young men thrive, \q and new wine the young women.
en.B: How good and how lovely they will be! \q The young men will flourish on grain, \q and the young women on new wine.
en.R: How good and beautiful they will be! \q The young men will grow strong on plenty of grain, \q and the young women on plenty of new wine.

es.L: ¡Porque cuán grande [es] su bondad, y cuán grande su hermosura! \q El grano hará prosperar a [los] jóvenes, \q y el vino nuevo a las doncellas.
es.B: ¡Qué buenos y qué hermosos serán! \q Los jóvenes florecerán con el grano, \q y las doncellas con el vino nuevo.
es.R: ¡Qué buenos y hermosos serán! \q Los jóvenes se harán fuertes con mucho grano, \q y las muchachas con mucho vino nuevo.

fr.L: Car combien grande [est] sa bonté, et combien grande sa beauté ! \q Le blé fera prospérer [les] jeunes gens, \q et le vin nouveau les jeunes filles.
fr.B: Qu’ils seront bons, qu’ils seront beaux ! \q Les jeunes gens s’épanouiront grâce au blé, \q et les jeunes filles grâce au vin nouveau.
fr.R: Comme ils seront bons et beaux ! \q Les jeunes gens deviendront forts grâce à du blé en abondance, \q et les jeunes filles grâce à du vin nouveau en abondance.

sw.L: Kwa maana wema wake [ni] mkuu kama nini, na uzuri wake ni mkuu kama nini! \q Nafaka itawastawisha vijana wa kiume, \q na divai mpya wasichana.
sw.B: Jinsi watakavyokuwa wema na wazuri! \q Vijana wa kiume watastawi kwa nafaka, \q na wasichana kwa divai mpya.
sw.R: Watakuwa wema na wazuri kama nini! \q Vijana wa kiume watakuwa na nguvu kwa nafaka tele, \q na wasichana kwa divai mpya tele.

vi.L: Vì sự tốt lành của nó lớn biết bao, và vẻ đẹp của nó lớn biết bao! \q Ngũ cốc sẽ làm cho [các] chàng trai lớn mạnh, \q và rượu mới [làm cho] các thiếu nữ.
vi.B: Họ sẽ tốt lành và đẹp đẽ biết bao! \q Các chàng trai sẽ lớn mạnh nhờ ngũ cốc, \q và các thiếu nữ nhờ rượu mới.
vi.R: Họ sẽ tốt lành và đẹp đẽ biết bao! \q Các chàng trai sẽ khỏe mạnh nhờ có nhiều ngũ cốc, \q và các thiếu nữ nhờ có nhiều rượu mới.

ko.L: 그 선함이 얼마나 크며, 그 아름다움이 얼마나 큰가! \q 곡식은 청년들을 자라게 하고, \q 새 포도주는 처녀들을 [자라게 할 것이다].
ko.B: 그들이 얼마나 선하고 아름다울 것인가! \q 청년들은 곡식으로 무럭무럭 자라고, \q 처녀들은 새 포도주로 피어날 것이다.
ko.R: 그들은 참으로 좋고 아름다울 것이다! \q 젊은 남자들은 넉넉한 곡식을 먹고 튼튼해지고, \q 젊은 여자들은 넉넉한 새 포도주를 마시고 튼튼해질 것이다.

decisions.choice: how great its goodness and its beauty: the goodness and beauty of the LORD's people
alternatives: how great is his goodness, and how great his beauty (the LORD's)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "his goodness ... his beauty". It is read here of the people, the flock and the jewels of verse 16, to whom the next lines turn: young men and young women thriving on the harvest. It may also be read of the LORD: "how great is his goodness, how great his beauty!" (compare Psalm 27:4; 31:20). The word "beauty" is used mostly of people and things, not of God, which favors the first reading.

decisions.choice: grain and new wine: the harvest of a land at peace
decisions.reason: Grain and new wine are the chief harvests of the land and signs of the LORD's blessing (Deuteronomy 7:13; Hosea 2:24; Joel 2:19). In place of war, the young men and women of the land grow strong on its plenty.

decisions.choice: its goodness (L); they will be (B, R); thrive (B); grow strong on plenty of (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew's singular as "its", so that it can refer to the flock or the land; Balanced and Readable say "they", the people (m1). Balanced and Readable put the young men and women first.

decisions.choice: "sa bonté", "sa beauté", left open as the Hebrew
decisions.reason: French "sa" can refer to the flock, the land or the LORD, as the Hebrew "his" and the English Literal "its" leave it open (meaning decision m1); no deity_pronoun span is given.

decisions.choice: "그 선함", "그 아름다움", without the honorific
decisions.reason: As the English Literal "its", Korean leaves open whose goodness is meant (meaning decision m1), so it uses no honorific.
